snippet.title: Don't Die Alone (FULL GAME)
snippet.description:
Play here!: https://stephenw313.itch.io/dont-die-alone

I took September off to take part in the spooktober visual novel game jam........ and this is the finished product! I hope you enjoy :)

Petra's actually a character from Eternal Endings so this won't be the last you see of her
And as said at the start of the video, there will be updates to EE soon! So much progress has been made since the last video, I can't wait for you guys to see (The prologue is coming along great! Its super long)

Discord link: https://discord.gg/zk3JHfJ
